title: Quintessential Comforting Ukrainian Garlic Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring fermented garlic and a comforting mother sauce, now vegan-friendly. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, warm water, and yeast, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
In a large skillet, saute the minced garlic in melted vegan butter until fragrant.
Add the mother sauce base to the skillet and stir to combine.
Place the dumplings in the skillet, spoon some of the garlic sauce over them, and cover with a lid.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
